notes: New 'Find for THIS PC' button in the Laptops tab. One click reads the make and model of the laptop the app is running on (and, where Windows exposes it, the fitted panel's maker and EDID code), drops it into the search and finds the matching screen or battery straight away — then search your suppliers or add it to the ticket. Works for screens or batteries depending on which you're viewing; on a desktop it says so and searches by model anyway. Always confirm against the sticker.
